answer: The stonecutter yard is white with dust, and blocks wait in rows under the canvas. Proof of stonecutter via block dress tally — a block the stonecutter dresses only after 23 blocks sit square on the bed, each block dressed by the stonecutter himself. glacier marks the face with chalk and scores the line with the chisel. yarrow splits the block along the grain with wedges and patience. fable dresses the bed flat and checks it with the straight edge. A forger needs 23 blocks that all sit square, and the next one still rocks where the bed ran soft.
